test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Flout
solution: The correct answer is '**Defy'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Flout **means to openly disregard a rule or law. (किसी नियम या कानून की खुलेआम अवहेलना करना) • **For example- ***He decided to flout the speed limit and was pulled over by the police.* • **Defy **also means to openly resist or refuse to obey. (खुलेआम विरोध करना या आज्ञा मानने से इंकार करना) • **For example-** *He defied the authorities by refusing to pay the fine.* • From here, it is clear that the most appropriate **synonym **for 'Flout' is 'Defy.' Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Rude **means impolite or discourteous. (असभ्य) • **Poke **means to prod or jab with something pointed. (किसी नुकीली चीज से ठोंकना या चुभाना) • **Rash **means reckless or impulsive. (लापरवाह या आवेगी) f0:Tb6f, The correct answer is: Devoted
